description: Status of every deployed service: replicas, restarts, resource use against requests and limits, ingress traffic, errors, latency and error logs. Filter by namespace; click a workload for the detail dashboard.

links.title: Alert rules
links.tooltip: Grafana-managed alert rules and their current state

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets in the selected namespaces with at least one desired replica.

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Degraded workloads
panels.description: Workloads with fewer available replicas than desired. The alert waits 10 minutes (3 minutes when none is available) so rollouts do not page.

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) - on (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods waiting with an error reason, Pending, Unknown, Failed (Job/Workflow pods excluded) or Running but not Ready.

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1) or max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_init_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",reason!="PodInitializing"} == 1) or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"} == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind=~"Job|Workflow"}, "reason", "$1", "phase", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",condition="false"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",phase="Running"}) == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "reason", "NotReady", "", ""))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container restarts (1h)
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected namespaces in the last hour, including sidecars.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Ingress requests
panels.description: Requests per second at the ingress gateway for services in the selected namespaces.

targets.expr: sum(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

panels.title: Ingress error rate
panels.description: Failed share of gateway requests (5xx and transport code 0, excluding client disconnects) for the selected namespaces. Alert threshold: 5% for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace",response_code=~"0|5..",response_flags!="DC"}[5m])) / sum(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: One row per Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet. Restarts count the last hour. CPU / request compares usage with the sum of requests. Worst memory / limit is the highest container in the workload (sidecars included); N/A means no memory limit. Click a workload for its detail dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", ""))

max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", ""))

round(sum by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"})))

sum by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

100 * sum by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"})) / sum by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

sum by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (100 * max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}) / on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory"}) > 0) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

defaults.noValue: No workloads in the selected namespaces

panels.title: Ingress traffic (reported by the Istio ingress gateway)
Services
panels.description: Per-service traffic over the last 5 minutes. Errors are 5xx and transport code 0, excluding client disconnects (DC). Services without recent traffic are not listed.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

100 * sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace",response_code=~"0|5..",response_flags!="DC"}[5m])) / sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))

defaults.noValue: No ingress traffic in the last 5 minutes

panels.title: Requests by service
panels.description: Requests per second per destination service.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: Error rate by service
panels.description: Failure percentage per service. Only services with failures are drawn. The dashed line is the 5% alert threshold.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace",response_code=~"0|5..",response_flags!="DC"}[5m])) / sum by (destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: p95 latency by service
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration per service at the gateway.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",destination_service_namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU by workload
panels.description: CPU cores used by each workload, sidecars included.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

panels.title: Memory by workload
panels.description: Working set memory of each workload, sidecars included. This is the value the kernel compares with memory limits.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"}))

panels.title: Restarts by workload
panels.description: Container restarts per 10 minutes for each workload. The repeated-restart alert fires at 3 restarts of one container within 15 minutes.

targets.expr: round(sum by (namespace, workload) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[10m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(workload) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",workload_type=~"deployment|statefulset|daemonset"})) > 0)

panels.title: Error log lines by workload
panels.description: Log lines per minute that look like errors (level=error/fatal, ERROR, FATAL, panic, exception) from Loki, by Kubernetes job (namespace/name).

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace"} |~ "(?i:level[\"=: ]+(error|fatal|critical))|\\b(ERROR|FATAL|CRITICAL)\\b|panic:|Exception" [1m]))

panels.title: Recent error logs
panels.description: Most recent error-looking log lines from the selected namespaces (up to 200). Narrow the namespace selector to read one service.

targets.expr: {namespace=~"$namespace"} |~ "(?i:level[\"=: ]+(error|fatal|critical))|\\b(ERROR|FATAL|CRITICAL)\\b|panic:|Exception"
